item.title: Lone bettor wins Php 11.2M Lotto 6/42 jackpot on February 7, 2026
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – Lone bettor bagged Php 11.2 million jackpot prize in the Lotto 6/42 draw on Saturday, February 7, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced. The lucky player hit the winning combination 42-10-05-13-20-19 with a total jackpot prize of Php 11,235,564.13. item.title: EJ Obiena wins gold in 12th Asian Indoor Athletics Championships
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – EJ Obiena claimed his second victory of the 2026 season after winning the gold medal in the men’s pole vault at the 12th Asian Indoor Athletics Championships in Tianjin, China. Photo courtesy: Facebook/EJ Obiena The Filipino Olympic pole vaulter dominated the final at the Tuanbo Sports Center on Saturday to add another international title to his early-year campaign.
